testton.anhoerenText: Plays the final-whistle tone on this device, at this device's volume. For checking and adjusting. Nothing is heard in the hall.
testton.anhoerenTextGeraet: Plays the final-whistle tone on this device ({{name}}), at this device's volume. For checking and adjusting. This device is a hall speaker: the tone is also heard in the hall.
testton.halleText: Plays the final-whistle tone once on the field's hall speaker. Afterwards this page shows when it was played.

testton.fehler: No test tone: that did not work

einrichtung.schritt1Text: Its own window; the browser puts it to sleep less often.
einrichtung.schritt1Ohne: In the browser menu choose “Install app” or “Add to Home Screen”.
einrichtung.schritt2Text: Then you choose which fields this device plays for.
einrichtung.schritt3Text: The browser only plays audio after a click. The “Activate audio” button appears at the bottom once a field is chosen.
einrichtung.schritt4Text: Then “Test tone in the hall” plays the final whistle once, and here it says “played” with the time.

anleitung.einleitung: So that the browser does not put the speaker to sleep:
anleitung.schrittAdresse: Open this address in a new tab:
anleitung.schrittSuchen: Search for “Always keep these sites active” and click “Add”.
anleitung.schrittApp: Enter the address of this app:
anleitung.safariText: Safari has no exception list and does not tell the app when it puts it to sleep. Keep this app’s window open. After every reload, click “Activate audio” again.
anleitung.pruefen: The app does not check this. If the browser reports that it put the speaker to sleep, it says so here and in the header.

aktivieren.hinweis: After a reload the browser needs another click.

abloesen.frage: Field {{feld}} already has a hall speaker ({{name}}). Replace it?
abloesen.frageMehrere: These fields already have a hall speaker: {{liste}}. Replace them?
abloesen.folge: After that only {{eigen}} plays for {{felder}}. The previous device then shows “taken over by another device”. There is no button to take it back; there you choose the field again as the first time.

wechseln.frage: This device is already hall speaker for ‘{{turnier}}’. Switch?
wechseln.frageOhneName: This device is already hall speaker for another tournament. Switch?
wechseln.folge: After that it only plays for this tournament. In the other tournament the fields say “no hall speaker”.
wechseln.alteAbmeldung: In ‘{{turnier}}’ the speaker could not be removed – please switch it off there yourself.
wechseln.alteAbmeldungOhneName: In the old tournament the speaker could not be removed – please switch it off there yourself.

anmelden.text: To set up the hall speaker, sign in with the tournament director’s account. This section then opens again.

toeneKarte.text: Hall speaker, volume and test tone are now in the sub-page “Hall tone”.
